newsitem.title: USA: Pepsico to reorganize U.S. bottling business.
newsitem.headline: Pepsico to reorganize U.S. bottling business.

text.p: Snack food and beverage giant PepsiCo Inc. confirmed on Monday that it would create a separate unit for its $6 billion-a-year bottling operations.
A PepsiCo spokesman denied suggestions from Wall Street analysts that the restructuring is a prelude to a spinoff of the botting operations as a separate company.
"It's just a new way to structure our business by bringing additional resources and managerial talent to each segment of the company," said Brad Shaw, the PepsiCo spokesman.

The bottling operations had about $6.0 billion in revenues in 1996, according to Skip Carpenter, an analyst at Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette. The operation will have 1997 revenue of about $6.4 billion, he said.
Earlier this year, PepsiCo said it would spin off its three fast-food operations -- Pizza Hut, Taco Bell and KFC.
The company said at the time it would spin off the units to focus more closely on its international beverage business.
